payload.title: Spike: Google sign-in through Cognito hosted UI from Alexa app linking and Echo Show QR
payload.description: Before building, check with a throwaway dev skill and the pilot pool: does account linking through the Alexa app (iOS) and through the Echo Show QR on a phone browser complete Google sign-in through the Cognito hosted UI? Record the results, the certificate check on the hosted UI domain, and any user-agent issues. Decide the custom-domain need. Write the findings into this epic before the next task starts.
